author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art: realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; lighter fantasy book; open to styles; portraits for now, more if the style fits; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. For the map: detailed, immersive, classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites. Author was still reviewing work in replies.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. Looking for artists that draw anime/manga, cartoon/semi-cartoon, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic, and other styles. Comment if interested or DM directly. Follow-up from author: still checking portfolios; people who have not sent a portfolio can share a link to previous work. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.

author: Bee (Shel)
title: Paid character and concept art for fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I’m a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I’m looking for artists to help bring it to life. Starting small, but this is paid work. Looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates. Contact: comment with work and rates or DM @bee.chaoticcore.
